title: Plaid’s Zach Perret Opens up on Open Banking | TechCrunch Disrupt 2023
description:
Plaid has had a thousand lives. After a $5 billion acquisition deal with Visa that fell through due to regulatory concerns, the company didn’t hit the pause button. Instead, it has been relentlessly rolling out features and raising money to make the dream of open banking a reality. Plaid CEO Zach Perret opened up at TechCrunch Disrupt 2023 on what it was like to move on from such a huge acquisition, and what the future holds for the company and the digital banking space.  #TCDisrupt2023 #Technology #Startups
